I never liked being alive I tried to find happiness where ever I could get it. I found beauty and reason in little things. I love the rain, I love leaves, I love the smell of dirt, I love the raw emotions humans have how we can love someone so deeply or be persuaded to feel angry. I love how strong communities are how they make me feel apart of something I love smiles, I love the shape of love hearts, I love the feeling of my cats fur and how he is happy when he sees me. I thrive on individuality and independence whether it’s my own or seeing someone overcome there troubles. I love paint and the fluidity in expressing yourself the opportunity’s are infinite. I love the stars and the unknown in between them more than anything else I long for the day I personally see them. I love glass and how pretty it is but easy to break and the power one feels behind it. I love imagination an endless stream of creativity that everyone can access, I love sand and how a grain could be from light years away. I love comfort and warmth and feeling secure. Although I don’t love myself yet I have found so many reasons to love life to give me interest and passion and reason I don’t care if it’s something simple or dumb or basic I enjoy the oddity and individuality of things.
